findings.title: Repo-controlled intent baseline is interpolated into git diff argv, giving arbitrary file truncation and a silent Tier-1 gate bypass
A scanned repository's own settings.json arms a backend whose binary is then resolved from that repository's directory (Windows)
Agent-CLI worker binary is resolved with the scanned repository's own directory ahead of PATH (Windows)
Skeptic verdicts are never bound to the lens they were requested for, so any worker can cast the spec-intentional veto
Spec-citation corroboration accepts any identifier-shaped token, not the SPEC-/ADR-/BEH- namespace its own spec documents
--covering trusts a hand-editable, repo-committed behavior.json as verified test-backed evidence
The status census silently reports zero open findings for any findings.json status outside its vocabulary, with no note
detect_infrastructure globs and reads every YAML in the scanned tree, following directory symlinks out of the project
The security report template reproduces a discovered plaintext secret verbatim in a git-tracked artifact
Cached graph's commit field is interpolated into a git revision argument unvalidated
verify-intent --advance rewrites the G1 baseline without re-running the gate, permanently clearing an unauthorized accepted-test edit
Untrusted behavior titles and paths are written unescaped into the generated BACKLOG.md tables
An absolute locator or entry in spec frontmatter discards the project root, so the Tier-1 gate stats and reads files outside the project
Import resolver's containment check is lexical, so a .. in a tsconfig paths target or a workspace subpath resolves outside the project root
graphify source_file becomes a graph key with no project-containment check, producing an out-of-project node that validates clean
Skeptic prompts interpolate the entire finding dict, including any credential in codeSnippet, into a subprocess argv element
The docs-manager ENVIRONMENT worker has no rule forbidding real secret values in the committed environment doc
Pages deploy workflow holds pages:write and id-token:write while depending on four mutable action tags
Committed project settings pin the toolkit's own repo to an unpinned optional third-party binary
Git-reported filenames passed as bare positional args to the code-graph child CLI
uninstall_agent removes any symlink pointing into the store's skills/, including names the installer never created
A committed directories key that escapes the project root is folded rather than refused, so ../shared graphs and reads a sibling tree and gives every in-project file a duplicate node
A committed file symlink pointing outside the project is scanned and its contents published, with nothing declared
